thesis: A net-cash, newly profitable digital remitter with rising margins and a 9.30% FCF yield trades at the bottom of its own P/FCF range, pricing a fade its raised guidance does not show.
reason: Fundamentals improved further since the BUY: margins and returns all rising, guidance raised, net cash. The fall since the high has no sourced cause and does not break the thesis. The position is at its target size, so HOLD; the top-up rule covers drift.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 8%, reversing most of the step-up from 2.2% a year earlier to 13.0%.
TTM ROIC falls below 20%, showing the returns step-up was not durable.
TTM FCF margin falls below 12%, back near the 11.1% of a year earlier.
A regulatory outcome (AUSTRAC or US remittance rules) restricts a major corridor or imposes a material penalty, disclosed in a filing.
